SPY.title: Palantir Just Joined the S&P 500. History Says the Artificial Intelligence (AI) Stock Will Do This Next.
SPY.description: Palantir, an AI company, has recently joined the S&P 500 index. While this may lead to increased investment, research suggests that any direct effect is short-lived, and a stock's performance is more likely due to pre-existing momentum. The article analyzes Palantir's financial metrics and growth potential, but expresses concerns about its high valuation.
SPY.author: The Motley Fool
